verifyBanner.text: Please confirm your email address {email} to invite others and accept invitations.
verifyBanner.sent: We sent you a new confirmation link.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.comingTitle: Calendar views are on their way
calendar.comingText: Month, week, day and agenda views arrive with the next update. Your calendars are already listed in the sidebar.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Clubs, teams and families you share calendars with.
groups.emptyText: Create a group for your club, team or family, then invite people by email or link.
groups.frozenHint: This group is over its plan limit: role changes and new members are paused until it is back within the limit. Removing members still works.
groups.notFoundText: This group does not exist, or you are not a member (any more).

roleHints.owner: Everything, including roles, billing and deleting the group
roleHints.admin: Invites and manages members and viewers
roleHints.member: Sees the members and adds to group calendars

createDialog.title: Create a group
createDialog.description: You become its owner and billing owner. You can invite people right after.
createDialog.name: Name

members.title: Members
members.hidden: Only members, admins and owners can see the member list of this group.
members.lastOwnerHint: Only owner: make someone else an owner first.
members.billingOwnerHint: Billing owner: transfer billing to another owner first.

roleDialog.title: Change role of {name}
roleDialog.description: Roles decide what someone may do in the group and its calendars.
roleDialog.selfDescription: You can lower your own role, but not raise it again.

revokeShares.label: Also revoke individual event shares
revokeShares.hint: Removes event permissions given to {name} personally in this group's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.
revokeShares.selfHint: Removes event permissions given to you personally in this group's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.
revokeShares.demoteHint: Also removes event permissions given to {name} personally in this group's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.description: {name} loses access to the group and its calendars. You can invite them again later.

leaveDialog.title: Leave {group}?
leaveDialog.description: You lose access to the group's calendars. To come back, you need a new invitation.

transferDialog.title: Make {name} the billing owner?
transferDialog.description: Their plan will govern the group from now on (limits like members per group). You stay an owner.

errors.lastOwnerLeave: You are the only owner. Make another member an owner before you leave, or delete the group.
errors.lastOwnerDemoteSelf: You are the only owner. Make another member an owner before you give up the owner role.
errors.lastOwner: {name} is the only owner. Make another member an owner first.
errors.billingLeave: You are the billing owner. Transfer billing to another owner (in the member list) before you leave.
errors.billingDemoteSelf: You are the billing owner. Transfer billing to another owner before you give up the owner role.
errors.billing: {name} is the billing owner. They have to transfer billing to another owner first.
errors.billingMustBeOwner: Billing can only go to an owner. Make {name} an owner first.
errors.frozen: This group is over its plan limit, so roles can't change and nobody can join right now. Removing members still works.
errors.forbidden: Your role in this group doesn't allow this.
errors.hasCalendars: This group still owns calendars. Delete them or move them to someone else first.

invites.title: Invite people
invites.byEmailText: We send a personal invitation. It only works for an account with this address.
invites.byLinkText: Anyone with the link can join until it expires or is used up. Links give at most the member role.
invites.linkOnce: Copy the link now: for security it is shown only once.
invites.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the link and copy it manually.
invites.revokeText: The link or email invitation stops working right away.
invites.noPermission: Only admins and owners can invite people and see pending invitations.
invites.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address to invite people.

settings.title: Group details
settings.description: Name and description are visible to all members.
settings.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change the group details.
settings.billingText: The billing owner's plan governs this group's limits.
settings.billingHowTo: To hand over billing, open the actions of another owner in the member list.
settings.leaveText: You lose access to the group's calendars.
settings.dangerText: Deletes the group, its memberships and invitations for everyone. The group's calendars must be deleted or moved first.
settings.deleteConfirm: This can't be undone. Type the group name to confirm.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.description: Join the group to see and edit its shared calendars.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to accept the invitation.
invite.afterSignUp: After creating your account, confirm your email address. Email invitations are accepted automatically then; for links, come back here and sign in.
invite.invalidText: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask for a new link.
invite.expiredText: The invitation is invalid, has expired, was revoked or was already used. If you already joined, you find the group under Groups. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.
invite.mismatchTitle: This invitation is for another email address
invite.mismatchText: You are signed in as {email}. Sign out and sign in (or create an account) with the address the invitation was sent to.
invite.unverifiedText: To join groups, confirm {email}. Open the link we sent you, then come back to this page.
invite.frozenTitle: This group can't take new members right now
invite.frozenText: The group is over its plan limit. Ask the group's owner to free up space, then try again.
invite.loadError: The invitation could not be loaded.

settings.description: Manage your profile and how you sign in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How others see you and how dates and times are shown to you.
profile.timeZoneHint: Event times are shown in this time zone.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorDescription: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
security.offText: Use an authenticator app such as 2FAS, Aegis, Google Authenticator or 1Password.
security.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before turning on two-factor authentication.
security.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
security.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually:
security.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code from the app and your password
security.disableText: Your account will be protected by your password only. Confirm with your password or a current code.
security.regenerateText: Your current recovery codes stop working. Confirm with your password or a current code.
security.recoveryLeft: No recovery codes left | One recovery code left | {n} recovery codes left
security.recoveryLow: You're running out of recovery codes. Create new ones so you don't get locked out.
security.recoveryFileHeader: sCalenderPlus recovery codes. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
security.codesText: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.

auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A passphrase of a few words works well.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back. Sign in to your calendars.
login.secondFactorExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please enter your password again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Share calendars with per-event permissions. Free to start.
register.doneText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address.
register.doneHint: You can already sign in. Didn't get an email? Check your spam folder or request a new link after signing in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.doneText: If an account exists for {email}, you'll receive a link to reset your password. The link is valid for one day.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Your new password signs you out on all other devices.
reset.doneText: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidText: The reset link is invalid, expired or was already used. Request a new one.

verify.title: Confirm email address
verify.doneText: Thanks! You can now invite others and accept invitations.
verify.invalidText: The confirmation link is invalid, expired or was already used.
verify.errorTitle: We couldn't confirm your email address

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.rateLimitedRetry: Too many attempts. Please try again in {wait}.
